_comment: METARA logo database. Layer 0 = universal marks used regardless of venture. Layer 1 = category families (Nonprofit, Commercial, Social Enterprise, Cooperative). Layer 2 = individual venture marks nested under a family. Update this file whenever a logo is added, renamed, or reassigned.

logos.name: Cosmic Egg (hero emblem)
logos.description: Hero emblem: core mark + Merkaba (two interlocking tetrahedra, hidden-line-removed) + orbiting Platonic solids ring (synchronized radial-axis rotation, 24 precomputed keyframes/solid) + arced METARA wordmark (live text, Cormorant Garamond).
logos.notes: Rotation frame data lives in the inline <script> at the end of index.html. No runtime geometry computation -- all keyframes precomputed.

logos.name: METARA core mark (two-square / eight-point star)
logos.location: index.html, embedded inside both .hero-logo-svg and .nav-logo-mark svg, and reused as the shared foundation of every venture logo below
logos.description: The universal blue/cream/orange eight-point star mark with spoke-and-circle decoration, extracted as true vector paths from logo-metara-v3.ai. Identical across all venture logo variants -- confirmed as the Layer 0 anchor mark.

logos.name: METARA menu/nav logo
logos.description: Standalone nav-bar version of core-metara-mark, tightly cropped, no surrounding ring geometry.

logos.name: METARA Living Solutions
logos.location: index.html, ventures list, .venture-logo-inline-wrap[aria-label="METARA Living Solutions logo"]
logos.description: core-metara-mark + amber/gold Platonic-solid corner icons + arc text 'METARA' / 'LIVING SOLUTIONS'.

source_files.light: METARA Living Solutions/logo-living-solutions-light.svg (cream stroke, used on site -- dark background)

logos.notes: Integrated v30 (2026-08): SVG ids namespaced with a 'living-' prefix to avoid collisions with the other four inlined venture logos on the same page.
